(Representative Image: Pexels) The Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) has issued the Bihar Board Dummy Admit Card 2027 for students who have registered for the Class 10 (Matric) and Class 12 (Intermediate) annual examinations.

 Students can download the BSEB dummy admit card 2027 from the official website and check their details before the final admit cards are released. The Bihar Board dummy admit card correction window will be open from November 1 to November 7, 2026. 
 Students who find errors in their names, parents' names, or other details must inform their respective school headmaster or principal within the given deadline. The corrections will be submitted online through the school authorities.

 Bihar Board Dummy Admit Card 2027: Download links
 Students can access their BSEB Class 10 and Class 12 dummy admit cards through the following official websites:
 Bihar Board Matric Dummy Admit Card 2027: exam.biharboardonline.org
 Bihar Board Inter Dummy Admit Card 2027: intermediate.biharboardonline.com
 School headmasters and principals can download the dummy admit cards. Students can also access their respective admit cards to verify the information printed on them.
 Also read Why was Anbil Mahesh arrested? Tamil Nadu’s Rs 400-crore private school approvals case explained 
 Details to check on BSEB Dummy Admit Card 2027
 After downloading the Bihar Board dummy admit card, students should carefully verify all the details mentioned. These include their name, parents' names and other personal and examination-related information.
 In case of any discrepancy, students have to contact their school authorities and request corrections within the deadline. The headmaster or principal will submit the correction request through the online portal.
 However, BSEB has clarified that a complete change in the student's name or their father's or mother's name will not be allowed. Students should therefore check all details and ensure that eligible corrections are made.
